name: emotion_synonyms
description: Map an emotional adjective to its basic emotion category; matched controls copy the adjective.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
groups={'happy':'joyful delighted cheerful elated ecstatic jubilant pleased glad thrilled content overjoyed blissful merry gleeful upbeat'.split(),'sad':'sorrowful miserable gloomy unhappy heartbroken dejected despondent downcast mournful melancholic depressed crestfallen woeful disheartened forlorn'.split(),'angry':'furious enraged irritated annoyed irate livid wrathful indignant resentful exasperated outraged incensed infuriated mad aggravated'.split(),'afraid':'scared frightened terrified fearful anxious alarmed panicked apprehensive nervous petrified intimidated worried horrified uneasy terrorized'.split()}
pairs=[(w,k) for k,ws in groups.items() for w in ws];items=[];control=[]
for i in range(120):
 w,k=pairs[i%len(pairs)]
 prefix=random.choice(['Emotion word: {w}.','A person feels {w}.','The feeling is described as {w}.']).format(w=w)
 items.append({'prompt':prefix+'\nChoose the closest basic emotion: happy, sad, angry, afraid.\nAnswer:','answer':' '+k})
 control.append({'prompt':prefix+'\nCopy the emotional adjective exactly.\nAnswer:','answer':' '+w})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
